fixes.explanation: Right, friend. She says, "Come, my beloved, let us go to the countryside; let us spend the night among the wildflowers." (Song of Solomon 7:11) She's the one doing the inviting here. She's the one who asks him to come along.

Yes, friend. She wants to see "…if the vine has budded, if the blossom has opened, if the pomegranates are in bloom…" (Song of Solomon 7:12) She names the vine, the blossom and the pomegranates. It's buds and blooms she's watching for.
